correctness.rationale: The two infective path frontiers each expose exactly one active edge at rates λ_A and λ_B until the gap is exhausted. Exponential memorylessness and time changes from peripheral infection events preserve the iid next-capture Bernoulli probability p=λ_A/(λ_A+λ_B). Hence X~Bin(m,p), and A territory Z_A=w_0+Σ_{j≤X}w_j, independent of off-path transition rates. In symmetric case, Var Z_A=m/4+2Σ b_j Cov(X,I_j)+Σ b_i b_j Cov(I_i,I_j). The covariances are positive; strict positive-definiteness of nested tail-indicator covariance implies maximizers concentrate B at one interior vertex, where central binomial and tail probability factors are largest. Minimum m/4 iff extras are seed-attached, maximum at center(s) with supplied formula. Independently exact evaluated m=3,B=4 gives maximum 31/4; m=2,B=2 gives both central maxima 9/4; boundary B=0 gives m/4. Finite CTMC checker was inspected but universal reasoning is analytical.
residual_risks: Bounded finite checks are only corroboration; universal quantifiers follow from the cited analytic proof.
